scripts.build-misskey-js-with-types: pnpm build-pre && pnpm --filter backend... --filter=!misskey-js build && pnpm --filter backend generate-api-json --no-build && ncp packages/backend/built/api.json packages/misskey-js/generator/api.json && pnpm --filter misskey-js update-autogen-code && pnpm --filter misskey-js build && pnpm --filter misskey-js api
scripts.start:test: ncp ./.github/misskey/test.yml ./.config/test.yml && cd packages/backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=test pnpm compile-config && cross-env NODE_ENV=test node ./built/entry.js
scripts.e2e: pnpm start-server-and-test start:test http://localhost:61812 "pnpm --filter frontend test:e2e"
scripts.e2e-dev-container: ncp ./.config/playwright-devcontainer.yml ./.config/test.yml && pnpm start-server-and-test start:test http://localhost:61812 "pnpm --filter frontend test:e2e"
scripts.vune:check: node scripts/check-vune.mjs packages/frontend/src && node scripts/check-vune-native.mjs packages/frontend/src
scripts.verify:modules: pnpm --filter @misutgaru/core test && node --test packages/modules/o0o0o/test/*.test.mjs && pnpm modules:build && node --test packages/modules/Vune/tests/vue-host-codegen.test.mjs packages/modules/Vune/tests/devtools.test.mjs packages/modules/Vune/tests/web-primitives.test.mjs packages/modules/Vune/tests/motion-planner.test.mjs packages/modules/Vune/tests/lazy-index.test.mjs packages/modules/Vune/tests/transition-lifecycle.test.mjs packages/modules/Vune/tests/presentation-primitives.test.mjs && node scripts/check-vune-native.mjs packages/frontend/src
scripts.verify:repo: pnpm verify:db-schema && pnpm verify:integrity && pnpm verify:modules && pnpm vune:check && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter backend typecheck
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify:repo && pnpm test && pnpm build:app
scripts.build:app: pnpm build-pre && pnpm -r build && pnpm build-assets
scripts.test:misutgaru-regressions: pnpm --filter backend exec vitest --run --config vitest.config.unit.ts test/unit/misc/cache.ts test/unit/misc/loader.ts test/unit/misc/request-batch-context.ts test/unit/misc/runtime-diagnostics.ts test/unit/core/CacheInvalidationService.ts && pnpm --filter frontend exec vitest --run --config vitest.config.unit.ts test/unit/cache.test.ts test/unit/prepared-note.test.ts test/unit/normalized-entity-cache.test.ts test/unit/variable-virtual-list.test.ts test/unit/paginator.test.ts
